nodes.Name: defaultMaxCount
nodes.ValueLiteral: flag.Int("quickchecks", 100, "The default number of iterations for each check")

nodes.Name: Generator
nodes.DocComment: A Generator can generate random values of its own type.

nodes.Name: randFloat32
nodes.DocComment: randFloat32 generates a random float taking the full range of a float32.

nodes.Name: randFloat64
nodes.DocComment: randFloat64 generates a random float taking the full range of a float64.

nodes.Name: complexSize
nodes.DocComment:
complexSize is the maximum length of arbitrary values that contain other
values.

nodes.Name: Value
nodes.DocComment:
Value returns an arbitrary value of the given type.
If the type implements the [Generator] interface, that will be used.
Note: To create arbitrary values for structs, all the fields must be exported.

nodes.Name: sizedValue
nodes.DocComment:
sizedValue returns an arbitrary value of the given type. The size
hint is used for shrinking as a function of indirection level so
that recursive data structures will terminate.

nodes.Name: Config
nodes.DocComment: A Config structure contains options for running a test.

nodes.Name: getRand
nodes.DocComment: getRand returns the *rand.Rand to use for a given Config.

nodes.Name: getMaxCount
nodes.DocComment:
getMaxCount returns the maximum number of iterations to run for a given
Config.

nodes.Name: SetupError
nodes.DocComment:
A SetupError is the result of an error in the way that check is being
used, independent of the functions being tested.

nodes.Name: CheckError
nodes.DocComment: A CheckError is the result of Check finding an error.

nodes.Name: CheckEqualError
nodes.DocComment: A CheckEqualError is the result [CheckEqual] finding an error.

nodes.Name: Check
CheckEqual
nodes.DocComment:
CheckEqual looks for an input on which f and g return different results.
It calls f and g repeatedly with arbitrary values for each argument.
If f and g return different answers, CheckEqual returns a *[CheckEqualError]
describing the input and the outputs.

nodes.Name: arbitraryValues
nodes.DocComment:
arbitraryValues writes Values to args such that args contains Values
suitable for calling f.
